messages.sourceEnglish: Confirm a mapped site’s country before using its crop-planning guidance.
messages.text: Khwathisedzani shango ḽa fhethu ho mapiwaho musi ni sa athu shumisa vhulangeli ha u pulana zwilimwa.

messages.sourceEnglish: Keep your sowing records and nursery equipment while local planning is unavailable.
messages.text: Vhulungani rekhodo dzaṋu dza u zwala na zwishumiswa zwa nese musi pulane ya henefho i sa athu vha hone.

messages.sourceEnglish: Crop planner → Site country and region
messages.text: Mupulani wa zwilimwa → Shango ḽa fhethu na vhupo

messages.sourceEnglish: Open your mapped site and confirm its country details. Country confirmation does not approve farming advice for a new region.
messages.text: Vulani fhethu haṋu ho mapiwaho nahone ni khwathisedze zwidodombedzwa zwa shango ḽaho. U khwathisedza shango a zwi tendeli nyeletshedzo dza vhulimi dza vhupo vhuswa.

messages.sourceEnglish: Crop planner → Planning without a mapped site
messages.text: Mupulani wa zwilimwa → U pulana hu si na fhethu ho mapiwaho

messages.sourceEnglish: For a virtual bed or local design, explicitly choose or remove the South African reference basis. The choice stays with that workspace.
messages.text: Kha mbethe wa maitele kana vhuvhambadzi ha henefho, nangani kana ni bvise mutheo wa tsumbo wa Afurika Tshipembe nga ho livhaho. Khetho i sala henefho kha vhupo ha u shumela.
